responsibility: Declares the GNU Modula-2 `libm` wrapper interface, exporting the typed math-function entry points used by runtime and generated code across scalar precisions. The header is the host math abstraction boundary for trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic, power, and rounding operations.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface header for the Glibm pair: it declares the exported libm_* wrappers across float/double/long double precisions, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/Glibm.cc provides the concrete forwarding implementations to the host math library.
